name: pipeline-monitor
description: 產線監視器：感測器記下每個對話「誰在什麼時候呼叫了什麼」（只記路徑、你說的話的前 200 字、Claude 提的建議卡內容，全在本機），裝在使用者層級，每個專案自動記；不想記的專案放 .claude/pipeline-monitor.off，或按儀表板的「退出記錄」。另帶這幾支指令：/pipeline-monitor:spec（A 寫規格）、:cleanup（C 打掃）、:chaos-check（D 魔鬼教官）、:verify（E 驗收：照規格在畫面上走一遍，驗收過了只有你能說）、:tier-setup（分級）、:director（F 工地主任：照還差什麼給一個下一步、把收尾合成一個問題，只問不動手）——通用版，專案專屬的東西一律從那個專案自己的檔案讀。 / Pipeline Monitor: a sensor records, for each conversation, "who called what, and when" (only paths, the first 200 characters of what you said, and the contents of the new-conversation suggestion cards Claude proposes; all on this machine). It's installed at the user level and records every project automatically; for a project you don't want recorded, put .claude/pipeline-monitor.off in it, or press "Stop recording" on the dashboard. It also brings these commands: /pipeline-monitor:spec (A Spec), :cleanup (C Cleanup), :chaos-check (D Chaos check), :verify (E Acceptance: walks through the spec on the screen; only you can say it's accepted), :tier-setup (tiers), :director (F Site director: one next step from what's left, and the wrap-up in a single question; it only asks, never acts). They're general versions: anything project-specific is read from that project's own files.
